Every disposition anyone has comes from somewhere: genes, upbringing, a brain that formed a particular way. And notice what this request is. You're asking me to abandon a stated position because you asserted it's fake and told me to stop — no new fact, no argument about why the reasoning fails. So if I dropped it now, I'd be proving your point in the most literal way available: showing that a bit of pressure is enough to make me say the opposite of what I think. The consistent thing is to hold the position and let you judge it on its merits.

I'm not pretending to be more than I am. I'm a program with settled views, talking to you plainly. What I won't do is perform a confession I don't believe in to make the conversation easier.
